items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: He also travels with Art Garfunkel.

ctx.x: Play any style, anywhere, anytime. He also travels with Art Garfunkel. Now see now you’re going oh yeah, see that’s something. To me that’s nothing. Yes. I shouldn’t say it’s nothing, it’s a good gig, it pays well. But musically it’s terrible.
